name: shotcut-mcp
description: Full transactional editor for Shotcut projects through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Edit complete Shotcut timelines with transactional safety.
interface.longDescription: Local Shotcut and MLT integration for source-quality analysis, creative multitrack editing, visual review, explicitly requested export, durable progress, backups, and delivery of rendered media with the exact editable project.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this Shotcut project is ready, explain missing media or services, and analyze its sources for quality issues.
Create a well-paced edit from my media. Choose cuts and transitions that fit my brief, then show a visual review.
Export this project as H.264, monitor the render, and deliver the video and exact editable project.
